$comment: Tessel module catalogue. Two consumers: the bot verifies this file against modules.json.sig and trusts ONLY `entries`; the website renders `entries` as Reviewed and `listings` as Unreviewed. Anything in `entries` has been read by a person at that exact commit and bundle hash — never add an entry without reviewing it, because the signature is what admins rely on. `listings` is for submitted modules nobody has reviewed yet; the bot ignores it completely.

entries.name: Ping
entries.description: Checks the bot is alive, and rolls a die. Asks for no permissions at all.
entries.author: anthonyf2312

listings.name: Welcome
listings.description: Greets people when they join, with a message you write. Can also say goodbye.
listings.author: anthonyf2312

listings.name: Moderation
listings.description: Catches invite spam, mass mentions and flooding. Warns, then escalates. Logs everything.
listings.author: anthonyf2312

review.reason: Awaiting review by a person. This module asks for messages.read, messages.manage, members.moderate, which can move server data elsewhere or take actions that are hard to undo, so it is not signed on an automated check alone. An automated review noted: settings commands do no authorization check of their own; deletes the offending message, which the description never mentions; undisclosed fourth rule: all-caps detection; warnings are not reset after a timeout, so every later violation re-times-out; flood counter only records messages that pass the earlier rules. None of this means the module is unsafe — it has not been cleared yet.

findings.title: Settings commands do no authorization check of their own
Deletes the offending message, which the description never mentions
Warnings are not reset after a timeout, so every later violation re-times-out
Flood counter only records messages that pass the earlier rules

entries[].commitSha: full 40-character commit sha that was reviewed
entries[].bundleSha256: sha256 of the esbuild bundle produced from that commit
entries[].name: display only
entries[].author: display only
entries[].icon: display only, absolute or site-relative image URL

$schema_notes.listings[]: same display fields as entries, minus commitSha and bundleSha256
